newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson slips ahead of '96 report.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson slips ahead of '96 report.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson was trading lower on Tuesday morning ahead of releasing its 1996 earnings.
After opening three crowns higher following gains in New York overnight, the stock slipped back to be 2.5 crowns below Monday's close in Stockholm at 249.5 crowns at 0940 GMT.

"We are seeing a bit of profit taking coming in before the report," said one broker. "Ericsson was up eight crowns on Monday. Also there is nothing else happening in the market here so all the focus is on Ericsson."
A Reuters poll of 18 analysts found market expectations of a 32 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 10.03 billion crowns for calendar 1996.
"It could come in below this but even so it does not mean the price will fall that much as there is so much liquidity in the market," a broker said.
